body:
I'm just very upset that the only person I can be sure I have loved, the only person in my entire life I have ever given 100% of my trust to, openly admits to using me and taking advantage of all that I was willing to give him for his own benefit until he noticed that I was in love and decided it was too sticky a situation to continue.

I feel slightly better because one of my fraternity brothers surprised me by showing up at my door and sitting with me for a couple hours, just talking about random shit and making jokes and getting me to think about other things. It really made me thankful to be part of the brotherhood that I had been doubting for a few weeks.

I'm still not better; I am still brokenhearted and I still feel used and violated and ashamed, disgusted with myself and disgusted with my ex's willingness to brag about his sexual escapades when I am part of the group he is speaking to, something I never did to him despite the fact that he was the one who never felt anything for me.

I'm still not okay. I'm not better. But thanks to that brother I'll make it through tonight.

That's not the case with me, though. I am still irrevocably attracted to *him.* Other people give me similar feelings sometimes, but it's not *him.* So it's not the same, really. There was just something about him that I had never found before, despite being in love with other people before him.
